input_evidence.name: issue
input_evidence.summary: #9376 [Automation] native-image run fails for org.eclipse.jetty:jetty-http:10.0.0; label=fails-native-image-run; body_chars=0

risks: The existing 9.4.1.v20170120 test project is shared and covers only MimeTypes. The metadata merged by the earlier fixTestNativeImageRun attempt lacked the reflection entry for Byte.valueOf(String), and likely the other wrapper types as well.
The metadata-version buckets in index.json stop at 9.4.x. 10.0.0 may need its own bucket, or a mapping to an existing one, once the native test passes.

The issue body was empty and I did not open the jetty-http 10.0.0 sources. Everything here comes from the preserved failure-analysis log. I did not trace TypeUtil's source, so the classification and sole-path steps are unverified.
libraryPreparationPreflight.summary: The failure is a missing reflection entry for java.lang.Byte.valueOf(String). TypeUtil's static initializer looks up valueOf(String) reflectively on the primitive wrapper classes, and reachability metadata can register that, so no extra dependency, Docker image or property is needed.
